title: Valve 的 Steam Frame 定价 1,059 美元起
content:
Valve's Steam Frame pricing starts at $1,059
Extended Reality
Business
PC
News
Valve's Steam Frame pricing starts at $1,059
Valve is also rolling out a developer kit for VR developers targeting its new headset.
Bryant Francis
,
Senior Editor
,
GameDeveloper.com
September 14, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
Image via Valve
Valve has announced the pricing and availability for the last of its three new major hardware products: the
Steam Frame
. The new virtual reality device will cost $1,059 for a basic 256GB model, while a 1TB model will cost $1,200.
Those costs are likely to be bumped further upward by additional accessories like a $29 power supply for standalone use (the Steam Frame can either act as an independent headset running SteamOS or as a device working off a separate computer). An "ergonomic accessories kit" will cost $59.
This price is much higher than that of the Meta Quest, which is currently the most mainstream VR device on the market. A 512GB Meta Quest currently costs $349.
Both
Valve
and
Meta
have both been forced to adjust their hardware pricing in the face of a sudden shortage of computer memory driven by exclusive deals struck by AI firms with major memory manufacturers like Samsung and SK Hynix. Valve's pricing also reflects its refusal to "
subsidize
" hardware like the
Steam Machine
in order to drive software sales.
Developers seeking to make games targeting the Steam Frame will also be able to acquire developer kits through their Steam Partner dashboard.
